concept: A warm pocket library where a few beloved books, soft lamplight, and a quiet reading corner make stories feel like a place.
floor: One broad continuous warm walnut library floor across the full top face, divided into only six to eight oversized smooth planks with no fine grain, tiny seams, loose pages, or rug.
main_structure: One compact open-front cream library nook at the rear with a broad curved burgundy roof, one large arched doorway, and two rounded side wings.
rear_props: two broad three-book shelves built into the library wings
one large lectern holding a single open blank book
side_props: one chunky cushioned reading chair, one three-book stack, and one broad reading lamp on the upper-left edge
one compact book cart with three oversized books and one broad reading lamp on the upper-right edge

perimeter.material: one continuous smooth burgundy library border with broad rounded segments
perimeter.emblems: four oversized simple gold closed-book emblems

materials: a few broad walnut timber blocks

lighting: soft warm daylight with three broad pools of amber reading-lamp glow
must_keep: exact canonical camera, canvas, footprint, stairs, tapered underside, and padding
entire bottom/front half as quiet open walnut floor
all additions inside the original silhouette
must_exclude: creature or egg baked into the bitmap
center circle, platform, plaza, ring, rug, paving, path, or indentation
bridges, clouds, readable writing, letters, watermark, external shadow
tiny book spines, loose pages, paper scraps, dense shelves, flowers, grass blades, pebbles, cracks, specks, or clutter
